newsitem.title: USA: Baker sees 1998 client spending growth.
newsitem.headline: Baker sees 1998 client spending growth.

text.p: Baker Hughes Inc said Wednesday it expected spending by clients to continue to grow at double-digit levels throughout 1998.

The company, which provides products and services for the oil and natural gas industries, reported third-quarter earnings of $0.56 a share after a tax-benefit gain against $0.33 for the same period last year.
It said oil revenues increased by 21 percent to $805 million during the quarter, compared with $665 million in the same quarter a year ago.

"Profit before tax on oilfield revenues increased 28 percent to $116 million from $91 million in the same period last year, with incremental profit before tax of 18 percent," it said. "Pre-tax operating margins were 14.5 percent versus 13.7 percent one year ago."
Total revenues were $897.3 million for the period against $765.9 million a year ago, it added.
Baker Hughes said its results were driven by increased activity and the introduction of new technology into key markets.
